classificationAudit.pickupRule: Exact original subsegmento CL - PICK-UP GRANDE or CL - PICK-UP PEQUENA; not inferred from brand.
classificationAudit.tritonRule: Exact Mitsubishi brand AND pickup rule AND normalized group containing TRITON or L200.

sources.name: Original geographic joins, population and GDP

limitations: QL = municipal Mitsubishi share divided by Brazil or UF share, always 2026-01 through 2026-10 Auto + Comercial Leve; no ratio across different periods or universes.
Registration address reflects fleets/headquarters and is not resident household demand.
Population 2026, GDP 2023 and additional public vintages remain separate; ratios are descriptive mixed-vintage exposures.
PAM planted area measures hectares of crops and can include successive crops; value of agricultural production is not agro GDP or household income.
VD includes multiple direct-sales customer classes, not only rental companies. Missing channels in 2016–2017 remain unknown.
LOCAL/IMP derives from retrospective model-level BD origin classification, never brand nationality. Unmatched remains unknown.

This descriptive regional artifact does not estimate forecast covariance; the independent UF × brand hierarchy and nonnegative MinT experiment are in phase3_hierarchy.json. No segment hierarchy is forecast.
